units.source_text: 沾了这熟睡的光，今晚又有没完没了不眠的抱怨了。

en.t: Thanks to this sound sleep, tonight would bring another endless round of complaints about sleeplessness.

units.source_text: 合着呼吸，他试着由一百倒着数。

en.t: Keeping time with his breathing, he tried counting backward from one hundred.

units.source_text: 试着仔细回忆从家门口到学校两点一线走惯了的道路。

en.t: He tried to recall in detail the familiar straight route he used to walk from his front door to the school.

units.source_text: 他又试着把自己所知道的昆虫，按科、目分开来排列。

en.t: Then he tried arranging all the insects he knew by family and order.

units.source_text: 结果都一样，什么效果都不见，徒然增加烦恼。

en.t: The result was always the same: none of it worked, and it only added uselessly to his irritation.

units.source_text: 风掠过洞的边缘，发出含含糊糊的声响……

en.t: The wind skimmed over the rim of the pit, making a vague, muffled sound...

units.source_text: 传来铁锹插入潮湿沙层的声音……

en.t: There came the sound of a shovel biting into the damp layers of sand...
The barking of dogs in the distance...

units.source_text: 像烛火似的摇曳，沙沙作响……

en.t: It wavered like candlelight, rustling softly...

units.source_text: 以神经末梢为目标，不间断地降下沙的粉屑……

en.t: Fine grains of sand fell without pause, as if aimed at the tips of his nerves...

units.source_text: 即使如此，还是得好好再忍耐一阵子。

en.t: Even so, he would have to endure it properly for a while longer.
